results.description: ZWJ insert/remove preserves constituent styles; explicit format expands to cluster and preserves constituent styles.
Immutable baseline candidate reconciliation passed detour, empty, tie-breaking and surrogate alignment.
Partial commit freezes committed attributes; later suffix edits or cancellation cannot alter frozen prefix.
Target expansion starts new attribution epoch; structural boundary composition rejected without prior bridge sync.
Queued format yields separate history groups; undo format preserves committed text; collapsed toggle creates no history; implicit preedit snapshot and redo verified.
Epoch lifecycle rejects stale events, caches duplicate stamps, expires evicted receipts, admits new sequences.
UTF-16 unit deletion allows isolated units, code-point deletion rejects malformed traversals, reversed selection and caret projection verified.
No-op style command creates no history/revision bump; exception cleanly rolls back all staged mutations.
Split/join/delete anchor mapping and table cell non-merging deletion verified.
Link interior/exterior boundary typing, whitespace exit, and heading bold suppression Value(false)/Clear verified.
Raw UTF-16 with isolated surrogates survives canonical persistence verbatim; valid-Unicode export generates conversion report and U+FFFD.
